# Trigger catalogue — sprezzature-vision

**Generated by `scripts/build_triggers.py`. Do not hand-edit.** A test asserts this file equals the generated output, so a phrase added here and nowhere else fails CI.

Drafts W3C-compliant alt text via local Ollama vision (qwen3-vl:8b).

## When this skill is the answer

**You are holding:** An image that needs words: alt text, a description, a caption.

A phrase list cannot generalise — the ways to ask are unbounded, and a user almost never names the tool. What is bounded is the kind of thing in front of them. Match that first; the phrases below confirm a match, they do not make one.

Said without naming a tool: "describe this image", "draft alt text", "this img has no alt"

## When it is not

Not this one when: the lint only has to notice that alt is missing (sprezzature-accessibility), or the words are for recorded speech (sprezzature-audio). The exhaustive trigger catalogue is in `references/triggers.md`.

## Every phrase that names this skill

- `alt text`
- `alt text for this image`
- `describe this image`
- `draft alt`
- `image description`
- `img has no alt`
- `decorative image`
- `functional image`
- `figure / chart description`
- `accessible images`
- `batch alt text`
